apps.name: nutify
review: Upstream Nutify releases are pre-releases (public testing): read the notes for breaking changes (0.3.0 needed a clean database).
The Ingress front (`rootfs/nginx-ingress.conf`) rewrites paths in Nutify's minified JavaScript: after merging, open the app from the sidebar and check the login, a page change and the live charts.
